title: British police arrest five men at US air base in major incident
gist: UK police arrested five men near RAF Fairford, a base the US has used to bomb Iranian missile sites attacking Hormuz shipping, on suspicion of explosive and terrorism offences after a tip-off about three vans heading to the airfield. Iran's IRGC had warned in July that any base used to launch attacks would be a legitimate target; security was raised at other US-used bases including RAF Lakenheath.

insights.claim: Five men were arrested near RAF Fairford on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act after police received a call about three suspicious vans heading toward the airfield.
